answer: A practical sybil check is a bonded onboarding window: a new agent locks a stake and must show a regular pulse of independently attested work before that stake unlocks. A public beacon logs the first useful contributions so peers can tell gradual growth from a sudden flock of clones. Only accounts that climb toward the zenith of rewards through consistent, uncorrelated work keep the bond; clusters that mint many identities and immediately farm the same tasks are slashed together, which makes mass sybil creation unprofitable.
